test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, if ‘CBVQ’ is written as ‘652520’ and ‘FRJT’ is written as ‘9211323’, how will ‘EHLP’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd096f94d4d1bbf2d1008c7a987a14c15f78fb79ff6a4fe7cecde5d8655b64db.png] 

**Logic:** Code is formed when (3) is added to the positional value of the given letters.

‘CBVQ’ is written as ‘652520’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/300ea48954ab914b76fb305badfecccc7a64c8b550d2ea22a0a7321a21af58b0.png] 

‘FRJT’ is written as ‘9211323’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/046e6e0e94f9cc7e5eee675d40b2189fae3b47f32462dc5767e065db4d9a56c3.png] 

Similarly, 'EHLP' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9659af2c20b687d0fb19e8fe208be9a094c049085e89d64d640ebe59230dcfed.png] 

Here, 'EHLP' is coded as** '8111519'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
